sources.title: Conservation area dataset
sources.facts: Work in progress, incomplete and contains duplicates; mixed authoritative and other sources.
sources.guard: Duplicate/incomplete catalogue cannot be treated as exhaustive exact-site evidence.

sources.title: Conservation area document dataset
sources.facts: Document catalogue from multiple planning authorities.
sources.guard: Document presence does not prove current designation or management-plan currency.

sources.title: Conservation area document type dataset
sources.facts: 6 types: appraisal, notice, designation report, map, management plan, design guidance.
sources.guard: Document type is taxonomy, not legal effect.

sources.title: Listed building dataset
sources.facts: 382,254 records; 2 providers; collector/new data 2026-07-29; point does not define extent.
sources.guard: Point is not listed-building extent or curtilage.

sources.title: Listed building grade dataset
sources.facts: 3 grades I, II and II*; authoritative origin; collector 2026-07-29.
sources.guard: Grade vocabulary is not condition or consent.

sources.title: Tree preservation order dataset
sources.guard: Catalogue record requires authoritative order/document and current-status check.

sources.title: Tree dataset
sources.facts: 250,104 trees; 75 providers; small-group specification-development origin; collector/new data 2026-07-29.
sources.guard: Tree record is not condition survey or complete national inventory.

sources.title: Historic parks and gardens dataset
sources.facts: Historic England attribution; current public HE GIS should be consulted.
sources.guard: Register geometry is not condition, ownership or development acceptability.
